Animated shorts on building

A series of short animations about ideas, incubation and luck.

Has anybody already built short animations that make an idea stick?

THE PROJECT · 5 VIDEOS

The question

How do you share an idea in under a minute?

The approach

Pick one idea, give it a world, a voice and a little personality, and tell it as a short animation.

The tradeoff

Short formats force you to cut everything but the core idea.

What to take with you

Start with the value, then make it memorable.
